description: Book-quality report (pdfnative 1.8 typography via generate_basic_pdf v1.7.0). `typography.splitParagraphs` lets paragraphs break across pages at a line boundary with `orphans` / `widows` of 3, `keepHeadingsWithNext` never strands a heading at the foot of a page, paragraphs are `align: "justify"` with `opticalMargins`, and `kerning` + `fontFeatures: ["onum", "smcp"]` apply to the embedded Noto Sans (`embedFonts: true` is what makes them effective). The second heading shows the per-block `keepWithNext`, the lead-in paragraph stays with the table that follows it. No hyphenation dictionary is installed on the server: the long compound carries soft hyphens (U+00AD). Self-contained: runs end-to-end with no placeholders. Preview the pagination with inspect_layout and the same `typography`.
